snippet.title: LAMBDA end THEORY - Minima Trailer
snippet.description:
LAMBDA end THEORY is a cryptic and minimalist RPG.

Play as LAMBDA,
a strange chara in search of Freedom.
Discover SUSTEMA and unlock the secret
of the mysterious Architect!

Now available on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1908570/LAMBDA_end_THEORY/

---

Soundtrack available on Bandcamp:
https://darxenas.bandcamp.com/album/lambda-end-theory-original-soundtrack

https://www.instagram.com/pixleaves/
